content.title: Trump Calls on Justice Department, FBI to Investigate JPMorgan’s Epstein Ties
content.summary: President Donald Trump, who is referenced in recently released correspondence between the late convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein and his associates, is publicly calling for an investigation into Epstein’s ties to influential figures and firms, including JPMorgan Chase.  Trump said in a post online Friday he would ask the U.S. Department of Justice and the Federal Bureau of Investigation to examine Epstein’s ties to the bank, former President Bill Clinton, former Treasury Secretary Larry Summers, and prominent Democratic donor and LinkedIn cofounder Reid Hoffman.
